cross_lane_decision_table.decision: Canonical snake_case TenantContextEnvelope; exact RFC 8785 without integrity; detached JWS EdDSA/Ed25519 with b64=false, crit=[b64], kid and canonical typ; canonical decimal string revisions; expires_at > issued_at; TTL <= 300 seconds; skew <= 30 seconds; current and retiring public keys.
New shared IDs use lowercase prefix plus uppercase Crockford ULID; provider and existing Brainbase IDs remain opaque; Brainbase adds op_<ULID>.
Ordered revision invalidation events plus authoritative expected-revision reads immediately before credential lease, Brainbase write, and Slack delivery; cache <= 30 seconds.

Protocol mana-brainbase-tenant-context request/response messages advertise range >=1.0 <2.0, supported versions and every required capability; select the highest mutual v1 minor without downgrade; deprecation notice >= 90 days.

Brainbase solely owns credentials and refresh; runtime uses opaque credential_ref and a lease_id/lease_token response bound to tenant, connection/revision, contract revision, operation, audience and credential mode; max_uses=1 and TTL <= 60 seconds; OAuth refresh uses CAS.

Brainbase owns credential_lease, quota_decision, business_effect and usage_receipt claims; mana-runtime owns queue_execution and slack_delivery claims. Brainbase emits canonical quota, UsageEvent and OperationReceipt wires with string revisions; all scopes use the fixed length-prefixed idempotency formula and terminal claims are retained >= 30 days.
collection_state collected|partial|not_collected is independent from outcome succeeded|failed|cancelled|timed_out; collected empty is NO_DATA with observed_units=0.
Brainbase has no Container execution implementation; consume sanitization status only as optional Receipt evidence.
Wire profile customer_managed_oss; only advertised optional capabilities can be non_applicable with reason; common controls never are.

tenant_context_envelope.canonicalization: RFC 8785 over envelope with integrity omitted
tenant_context_envelope.signature: RFC 7515 detached compact JWS EdDSA with Ed25519 over ASCII(protected64 + '.') followed by UTF-8 JCS(unsigned envelope); payload segment is empty and payload is not base64url encoded
tenant_context_envelope.time_order: expires_at must be later than issued_at

workspace_connection.revision_type: canonical decimal string matching ^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$ and monotonically increasing numerically

correlation_and_idempotency.length_prefix_encoding: LP(v) = uint32be(UTF-8 byte length of v) followed by UTF-8 bytes of v
correlation_and_idempotency.derivation: ik1_ + base64url_without_padding(SHA-256(LP(protocol_id) || LP(protocol_major) || LP(tenant_id) || LP(connection_id) || LP(slack_event_id) || LP(operation_id)))
correlation_and_idempotency.conflict_rule: same key after claim with different payload_hash or context_hash is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
